caption: A bowl of miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and vibrant green scallions. Served in a white bowl with red trim, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface texture.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, marbled texture with browned edges and glistening surface.
The miso broth is creamy yellow, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with red rim, smooth surface, and subtle red pattern near edge.
